Merged in PR #15: no checkpoint, decision recorded in docs/marks-resume.md. Measured -- a 74-min scan costs 536.6s (8.3x realtime), so nine minutes is the whole exposure, against ~1,300 lines of resume machinery. The correctness objection (a resumed scan cannot reproduce the sampling grid) was checked and is FALSE: all three ffmpeg seek forms reproduce the tail byte for byte. It was decided on shape instead -- a checkpoint spilling fingerprinted tile grids is most of a whole-file tile cache already, and a cache also serves re-running with a different --budget/--delta.
